summary: hetzner.hcloud removed the deprecated *_facts modules for datacenter, floating IP, image, location, server, server type, SSH key and volume.
questions: hcloud_server_facts is missing, what do I use?
What replaced the hcloud facts modules?

answer_card.title: hcloud *_facts modules removed
answer_card.answer_md: Removed: `hcloud_datacenter_facts`, `hcloud_floating_ip_facts`, `hcloud_image_facts`, `hcloud_location_facts`, `hcloud_server_facts`, `hcloud_server_type_facts`, `hcloud_ssh_key_facts`, `hcloud_volume_facts`. Use the matching **`*_info`** modules, e.g. `hetzner.hcloud.server_info`.
